description: This file defines classes and codecs related to key-value storage in the Superset project, including abstract codecs, JSON, pickle, and marshmallow codecs, as well as related enums and types.

classes.name: KeyValueFilter
classes.description: TypedDict for filtering key-value entries with optional resource, id, and uuid.

classes.name: KeyValueResource
classes.description: Enum representing different resource types for key-value storage.

classes.name: SharedKey
classes.description: Enum for shared key salts used in key-value storage.

classes.name: KeyValueCodec
classes.description: Abstract base class for key-value codecs with encode and decode methods.

classes.name: JsonKeyValueCodec
classes.description: Codec for encoding/decoding JSON data to/from bytes.

classes.name: PickleKeyValueCodec
classes.description: Codec for encoding/decoding data using pickle.

classes.name: MarshmallowKeyValueCodec
classes.description: Codec that uses Marshmallow schemas for serialization/deserialization.
